## [PUBLIC] Scope

Management skills cover project onboarding, integration hoppers, post-mortems, complexity tracking, and proof handoffs. This snapshot describes placement only; management leaves are not here.

## [PUBLIC] Placement

Add skills here for **operator workflows** that coordinate transfers, documentation fidelity, or corpus hygiene. User-facing domain logic belongs in `project-classes/`. Engine skills belong in `skillstack/`.

## [PUBLIC] Constraints

- Skills in this folder are operator-facing corpus tooling, not Board personas or domain charters.
- Named management skills are not in this snapshot. This pack does not include that hop. Fast path if the task is a local edit; otherwise ask the operator.
